learning_outcomes.text: Name the main outside parts of the body
Say what the eyes, ears, nose, tongue and skin help us do
Describe how the body moves and rests
Explain simple ways to keep the body healthy
Tell why food, water and sleep matter
Show how to keep the body clean and safe

integrative_case: A friendly robot wants to be like a child, so the class teaches it how a body sees, hears, moves, eats and sleeps to stay healthy and happy each day.
